axes.h2: Five specification axes across the series
axes.role: Each axis is confirmed per model and per order
cards: Material: PP or PS
Every model in this series can be produced in PP or PS. Confirm which one suits your volume and reuse plan in the quote.
Capacity: 12 oz to 22 oz
12 oz, 16 oz, 17 oz and 22 oz are recorded options. Any other capacity is reviewed as a custom mold project.
Color and color-change effect
Base color, printed pattern and the color the cup turns once cold liquid - or sunlight, on the sun-altering version - reaches it are all set per order. Send reference colors or a Pantone number.
Lid and straw
A lid and straw can be added as a configured option. Fit depends on the rim diameter, so it is confirmed per model and capacity.
UV hard-print logo
UV hard print is the standard decoration for this series. Screen print is reviewed for artwork with large solid areas; the usable print area is confirmed per model.

ref.note: Rows run from the smallest capacity to the largest. Every row is a separately quotable style; lid and straw are an add-on option on every row, fit confirmed per model and capacity when quoting.

axes.role: 每一项都按型号、按订单确认
cards: 材质：PP 或 PS
这一族每一款都能做 PP 或 PS。用哪一种、是否要反复复用，报价时一起确认。
容量：12 oz 到 22 oz
现有 12 / 16 / 17 / 22 oz 四个记录在册的容量。其他容量要开模，按开模项目谈。
颜色与变色效果
底色、印什么图案、遇冷（或日照款遇太阳）之后变成什么颜色，全部按单定。给参考色或潘通号即可。
杯盖与吸管
可以加杯盖和吸管，但要按杯口直径配，所以具体到哪一款、哪个容量，报价时确认。
UV 硬刷 logo
这一族默认 UV 硬刷。大面积实色可以谈丝印；可印区域按型号确认。

rows: 日照变色体育场杯（全彩）
ref.note: 表里按容量从小到大排。每一行都是一个能单独报价的款；杯盖与吸管是加配项，具体到哪一款、哪个容量能不能配，报价时确认。

axes.h2: Five specification axes across the series
axes.role: Each axis is confirmed per style and per order
cards: Finish: plain, red, translucent or full color
The recorded styles cover plain cups, red party cups, translucent cups and full color printing. Pick the finish first, then the capacity.
Capacity: 2 oz to 24 oz
2 oz, 10 oz, 12 oz, 16 oz, 17 oz, 20 oz, 22 oz and 24 oz are recorded. Any other capacity is reviewed as a custom mold project.
Lid and straw
Two styles already ship as a lid and straw version (12 oz and 20 oz). On the other styles a lid and straw can be added as a configured option, subject to rim diameter.
Material: PP or PS
PP covers the reusable stadium cups. The 2 oz party cups are recorded in PS. Confirm the material with the quote if you need one material across the whole order.
Custom print and logo
Full color print is recorded on three styles; the rest are quoted for screen print or UV hard print. Usable print area is confirmed per model.

rows: Stadium cup with lid and straw
Event stadium cup with lid and straw
ref.note: Every row is a separately quotable style. Lid and straw are included on the two styles listed as such, and available as an add-on on the rest; fit is confirmed per model and capacity when quoting.

axes.role: 每一项都按款式、按订单确认
cards: 表面：素色、红色、半透明、全彩
记录在册的款式覆盖素色杯、红色派对杯、半透明杯和全彩印刷。先定表面，再定容量。
容量：2 oz 到 24 oz
现有 2 / 10 / 12 / 16 / 17 / 20 / 22 / 24 oz 八个记录在册的容量。其他容量要开模，按开模项目谈。
杯盖与吸管
有两款本身就是带盖吸管款（12 oz 与 20 oz）。其余款可以加配，能不能配要看杯口直径。
材质：PP 或 PS
PP 覆盖可复用的体育场杯；2 oz 派对杯记录的是 PS。如果整单要统一一种材质，报价时说明。
印刷与 logo
有三款记录的是全彩印刷；其余款按丝印或 UV 硬刷报价。可印区域按型号确认。

rows: 半透明可复用体育场杯
赛事体育场杯（带盖吸管）
ref.note: 表里每一行都是一个能单独报价的款。标「含」的两款本身带盖和吸管，其余可以加配，具体按型号和容量确认。
